scripts.still: bun src/build.tsx && slopcamera html still --input out/scene.json --at 3,7,11.5,15.5,20,24.5,28.5,33,37.5 --output out/stills
scripts.still:portrait: bun src/build.tsx --aspect 9:16 && slopcamera html still --input out/scene.json --at 3,7,11.5,15.5,20,24.5,28.5,33,37.5 --output out/stills-portrait
scripts.dry-run: bun src/build.tsx && slopcamera html render --input out/scene.json --dry-run --json
scripts.render: bun src/build.tsx && slopcamera html render --input out/scene.json --json > out/export.json
scripts.render:portrait: bun src/build.tsx --aspect 9:16 --out out/portrait && slopcamera html render --input out/portrait/scene.json --json > out/portrait/export.json
scripts.deliver: slopcamera html deliver out/export.json --basename oh-launch --poster-at 7 --social-at 20 --cuts 1:1 --per-beat-clips --beats out/beats.json --output out/deliver
scripts.deliver:portrait: slopcamera html deliver out/portrait/export.json --basename oh-launch-vertical --poster-at 7 --social-at 20 --per-beat-clips --beats out/portrait/beats.json --output out/deliver-vertical
